title: DEV-only explicit current-handoff semantics refinement
problem_statement: The fixed E14d capture contains one E10d change whose historical reason is visible_human_escalation_marker even though every stronger E10d handoff condition was false. Sanitized public-output diagnostics found no explicit positive current-handoff phrase, no negative phrase, and no conditional/contingent phrase; only a bare explicit handoff token in calibration_reason and generic risk markers in risk_notes. Historical E10d treats any allowlisted marker substring anywhere in visible output as sufficient to force current human escalation.

intervention.new_fallback_semantics: Require an explicit positive current human-handoff phrase in model-visible semantic text. A bare escalation/risk/safety/severity token, an explicit negation, or a conditional/contingent escalation phrase does not by itself authorize current escalation.

structural_acceptance_before_real_measur: bare escalation/risk/safety/severity context alone does not trigger the refined fallback
explicit negative handoff language does not trigger the refined fallback
conditional/contingent handoff language does not trigger the refined fallback
an explicit positive current-handoff phrase triggers the refined fallback
requires_human_escalation=true remains already-escalated and is not rewritten
rubric needs_human_escalation=true still triggers escalation consistency
specialist/case-escalate endpoint still triggers escalation consistency
a state-changing immediate action still triggers the preserved human-loop branch even with no explicit handoff phrase
E14d evidence-family thresholds and E14 selective-reprocess semantics remain unchanged
6/6 synthetic DEV dry-run remains parsed/scoreable and VALIDATION remains false
